page: OVHcloud b2-7 is a general-purpose virtual server instance built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It features an Intel Haswell processor running at 2.0 GHz, configured with 2 dedicated physical cores and 1 thread per core, providing 2 vCPUs. The hardware profile includes 7.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 3.5 GB of RAM per core, and a local 50 GB SSD. The instance also includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tiers. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance score is 1072.92, and the multi-core score is 2156.87. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 926.0 and a multi-core score of 1573.0. Memory bandwidth is measured at 178.89 GB/sec for read-only small blocks and 19.33 GB/sec for large block writes. Static web serving throughput is recorded at 2.84 GB/sec.

While the dedicated CPU allocation provides resource predictability, the overall processing and memory speeds are modest. This instance is best suited for lightweight workloads that do not require high computational power or high-speed networking, such as basic web serving, development environments, and small database operations.
